reviewAccount.provisioning: Create a dedicated non-production reviewer account and enter credentials only in App Store Connect / Play Console review fields.

reviewNotes: Suqnaa is an Australia-focused marketplace for user-listed physical goods/services; user-generated listings and messages are moderated and reportable.
Use the dedicated reviewer account supplied in the store console. Do not use production customer credentials.
Payment and identity-provider flows may operate in approved sandbox/test configuration for review; no reviewer should be asked to make a real-money purchase or submit real identity documents.
Account deletion is available from Profile and privacy inside the authenticated app. Public deletion information is available at https://suqnaa.com/en/account-deletion.
If a reviewed feature is hidden by eligibility, region, verification or sandbox configuration, release notes must state the exact test condition and safe review path.
submissionChecks: Reviewer account signs in successfully on the submitted build.
No OTP, captcha, payment or identity step blocks review without documented test handling.
Test listing/order fixtures contain no real personal or financial data.
Support and privacy URLs are reachable over HTTPS.
Account deletion flow is reachable from the submitted build.
